description: This Java class 'CommonServices' provides a collection of utility and service methods for the OFBiz framework, including testing services, note creation, debugging level adjustments, entity operations, and metrics management.

classes.name: CommonServices
classes.description: A utility class providing various service methods for the OFBiz framework, including testing, entity management, debugging, and metrics.

methods.name: testService
methods.description: A simple service that logs the context entries and returns a success response, optionally including a message.

methods.name: testSOAPService
methods.description: Creates and returns a list of test 'TestingNode' entities.

methods.name: blockingTestService
methods.description: Pauses execution for a specified duration then calls testService.

methods.name: testRollbackListener
methods.description: Registers a rollback service and returns an error message indicating a rollback test.

methods.name: testCommitListener
methods.description: Registers a commit service and returns success.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note record associated with a party, using provided parameters.

methods.name: adjustDebugLevels
methods.description: Sets debugging levels based on input parameters.

methods.name: forceGc
methods.description: Invokes garbage collection.

methods.name: echoService
methods.description: Returns the input context as the response, indicating success.

methods.name: returnErrorService
methods.description: Returns an error message for testing error handling.

methods.name: conditionTrueService
methods.description: Returns success with conditionReply set to true.

methods.name: conditionFalseService
methods.description: Returns success with conditionReply set to false.

methods.name: entityFailTest
methods.description: Attempts to create an entity with invalid data to cause a referential integrity error.

methods.name: entitySortTest
methods.description: Logs the names of various model entities to test sorting.

methods.name: makeALotOfVisits
methods.description: Creates a specified number of 'Visit' entities with dummy data.

methods.name: displayXaDebugInfo
methods.description: Displays transaction resource debug info if enabled.

methods.name: byteBufferTest
methods.description: Writes byte buffer data to files in the OFBiz home directory.

methods.name: uploadTest
methods.description: Uploads a file and creates associated content resources.

methods.name: mcaTest
methods.description: Logs details of an email message for testing.

methods.name: streamTest
methods.description: Reads from an input stream and writes to an output stream, logging each line.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Checks database connectivity by counting 'SequenceValueItem' entities.

methods.name: getAllMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves and returns all registered metrics.

methods.name: resetMetric
methods.description: Resets a specified metric after decoding its name.
